Players Committee card image of [[Yavin 4: Massassi Ruins (V)]] (original printing), game text: “'''Light Side:''' If Yavin 4 'blown away', Force loss is reduced by 4. '''Dark Side:''' If Yavin 4 system on table, Force drain -1 here.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual9-Light/large/yavin4massassiruins.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/022435b7929e4de26dafbcb1de2ec1d6d04d2153 022435b] (8 July 2018). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
